study type: Prospective cohort study and registry study
exposure: Timing of cesarean delivery (before or after membrane rupture)
cesarean delivery after rupture of membranes
Cesarean delivery before rupture of membranes
cohort: 411 Danish children from the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood2000 and children born in Denmark between 1997-2010 from the Danish national prospective registry
finding: Cesarean delivery was confirmed to be a risk factor for childhood asthma, and this effect was more pronounced for cesarean delivery performed before rupture of membranes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery, particularly before membrane rupture, was associated with an increased risk of asthma in childhood.
